description.message: Adds the job offer you are reading, on any site, to your Indezy pipeline.

optionsHint.message: The address you open Indezy at, such as https://indezy.swirlit.dev. The extension reads nothing on the pages you visit: it hands Indezy the address of the page or link you choose.

optionsInvalid.message: Enter an https:// address without a path.
